result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **QuickBooks Online is the best overall accounting software**\. However, depending on your business size, industry, and budget, there may be a better option.

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

(Best overall)

Starting around \$38/month

- Income and expense tracking
- Bank account integration
- Invoicing and bill management
- Payroll and tax-related reporting
- Excellent accountant compatibility

Best for: Businesses that want a comprehensive accounting system that can grow with them.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)

**2\. Xero**

(Best for growing businesses)

Starting around \$27/month

- Clean, user-friendly interface
- Unlimited users
- Bank reconciliation
- Financial reporting
- Excellent integrations

Best for: Businesses with multiple employees or people managing finances.

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/)

Best for: Consultants, contractors, freelancers and service providers.

[Visit FreshBooks](https://www.freshbooks.com/)
